_about: The editorial layer of the area pages (oria-v4/taxonomy-area.php, inc/area-guide.php). Everything counted -- places, practices, hours, prices, nearby suburbs -- comes from the live listings and is NOT stored here. What is here is hand-written: a place's own photograph, its one-line character, the local-rhythm introduction, getting around, and the public places the reset plans can use. Keyed by area term slug. Every claim must be checked before 'reviewed' is set; a data refresh never touches this file. An area with no entry still gets the full page, with its region's or city's photograph and data-only copy. Images: 'place_verified' is true only where the photo's own source title names that place; the others are fitting scenes, not claimed as the place, and their alt text says only what is in the picture.

fremantle.tagline: Limestone streets, sea air and one of Perth's strongest pockets for breathwork.
fremantle.rhythm_intro: Fremantle's wellness rooms sit in the same few streets as everything else here: back from the water, above shops, in converted heritage buildings. Breathwork, remedial massage and art therapy are all a short walk apart, which makes it an easy place to put two things into one visit.
getting_around: Fremantle Station is the last stop on the Fremantle train line from Perth.
Parking in central Fremantle is run by the City of Fremantle — check the signs and rates before a long appointment.
